reminder.notes:
Release v2.23.0

### Features
- New App Logo: Implemented a modern 3D multicolor ribbon bell icon.
- App Theme Overhaul: Aligned light and dark theme colors to match the new icon's electric blue, indigo, and slate palette.
- Motion Gestures: Added optional gesture-based snooze and dismiss actions (flip to snooze, shake to dismiss).
- Location Picker History: Added interactive saved locations chips with long-press delete and add-current capabilities in the map picker.
- Actionable App Widgets: Added Complete and Snooze buttons directly onto the home-screen app widget rows with instant UI feedback and native alarm cancellation.

### Bug fixes
- Resolved minor layout and deprecation issues, updating obsolete withOpacity calls to withValues.
- Fixed a possible issue in the widget rendering where row IDs were not mapped, allowing clean complete and snooze events back to the native scheduler.

mirrordrive.notes:
Release v0.13.8+33

### Features
- Added Google Drive rename detection to avoid uploading modified/renamed files from scratch.
- Added custom ignore pattern manager in Settings to filter sync folders/files line-by-line.
- Added CPU wakelock to keep the phone awake during large background or interactive syncs.
- Implemented Google Drive resumable streaming uploads in constant memory, preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors for large files.
- Run duplicate files deletion in the background with a real-time progress card in the app.

### Bug fixes
- None.

twinclean.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

- The Settings screen now shows the installed app version and a PNSJY brand footer as its
  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
